items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Even when he was in the hospital he had Johnny Pate there rehearsing him for some kind of program that he wanted to do.

ctx.x: But always his heart was in it. Even when he was in the hospital he had Johnny Pate there rehearsing him for some kind of program that he wanted to do. He was always that performer. And the good thing about Joe, Joe recognized his image. He recognized that I have a podium where I can lift people. And that’s what his thing was. And so that’s what was in his heart. He had a lot of faith in the people that supported him, the doctor and everything like that. So the point is the ball didn’t bounce this time. It caught…
Well we’re about to run out of tape. We’ve been talking a long time but I love your comments and I wish you the best of luck with your Ellington project and all the good things you do.
